records.claim_text: IPASS publicly separates individual, employer/corporate, payroll-bureau and overseas membership branches, with differing qualification, billing and tax descriptions. This makes the member organisation, geography and benefit unit material when comparing support alternatives.
records.limitations: No price benchmark, tax advice, full licence interpretation, actual buyer preference or quality outcome. These are Irish payroll-support offers, not evidence that an Irish employer would buy The Table.
records.population: Published offer/terms or explicit researcher application, not original participant input.

records.claim_text: GPA publicly offers a global/in-country payroll resource and network catalogue including training, events, country information, a forum and a helpdesk route. A global payroll audience therefore has additional visible alternatives beyond the UK support membership reviewed in the first pass.
records.limitations: No paid-tier entitlement, price, actual usage or independent effectiveness verified. Catalogue breadth does not prove the alternative satisfies a particular investment decision.
records.population: Published offer/terms or explicit researcher application, not original participant input.

records.claim_text: Specify who pays, who can use the asset and the actual use: internal decision support, client advice, public marketing and resale can require different permissions and servicing. An adviser buying research for client work is not automatically covered by an employer/internal-use package.
records.locator: Analytical application: ISG enterprise/provider service distinction; TPC clauses5.1,6 and9
records.limitations: No assertion that every adviser is excluded or that exact ISG licence terms are known. No new JGA licence terms adopted. Seek the intended use selectively, not a mandatory procurement questionnaire.
records.population: Published offer/terms or explicit researcher application, not original participant input.

records.claim_text: Assess alternatives against the decision geography, country set, employer size and operating need, rather than the city of an event or a generic global-payroll label. A country compliance-support need and a cross-country investment decision may require different evidence and value.
records.locator: Analytical comparison of UK team support, Irish segmented membership and global/in-country resource catalogue
records.limitations: No country market size, willingness-to-pay, geographic exclusion or law equivalence inferred. Context is selective and case-specific; no new mandatory report question.
records.population: Published offer/terms or explicit researcher application, not original participant input.

records.claim_text: Define the intended research/member eligibility and how invitations are selected before assigning funder benefits. A sponsor target-list invitation route can serve commercial access objectives, while a research cohort may need a different role, country or decision-case mix. Keep any partner nominations distinguishable from independently recruited participants.
records.locator: Analytical application: iVentiv FAQ qualification/approval and live sponsor target-list inventory
records.limitations: iVentiv is an L&D mechanism comparator, not a payroll sample design. No assertion that nominations must be prohibited or that The Table has recruited anyone. No default sponsor contacts, guaranteed eligible attendees or representative claims.
records.population: Published offer/terms or explicit researcher application, not original participant input.

records.claim_text: Match each proposed commercial benefit to its actual delivery conditions and timing before modelling funding. Interest, accepted order, cleared cash, deliverable-ready research or seats, permitted publication and benefit delivered are separate states; funding received alone does not make every promised benefit deliverable.
records.locator: Analytical application: iVentiv approval/meeting/package/payment conditions and TPC start/payment/benefit conditions
records.limitations: No JGA cash dates, accounting recognition rule, deposit amount or legal contract advice. Generic iVentiv21/14-day conflict remains unresolved; do not import either interval. Later financial model needs its own sourced or explicitly assumed inputs.
records.population: Published offer/terms or explicit researcher application, not original participant input.

records.claim_text: The Payroll Centre terms describe an automatic renewal mechanism with reminder, termination and renewal-price provisions. This is a published contract mechanism for subscribed membership, not evidence of an actual retained customer base or achieved recurring revenue.
records.limitations: Do not adopt an automatic subscription for JGA or equate annual availability with contracted renewals. Actual customer contracts, opt-outs, renewal behaviour, receipts and margin are not inspected.
records.population: Published offer/terms or explicit researcher application, not original participant input.
